coverage.original_language: Lehrbuch der Algebra Bands 1 and 3 modern LaTeX reader drafts are front-facing.
coverage.translation: Lehrbuch der Algebra Volume II current English draft is front-facing through section 154, including the latest delivered continuation on modular equations, resolvents, and the theory of algebraic equations. A separate Volume I English draft on inverse substitutions, transformed substitutions, transposed substitutions, permutation substitutions, invariants, and finite binary polyhedral groups is also front-facing.
